items.title: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale
items.summary: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale Promptwatch is part of the emerging "GEO" space, for Generative Engine Optimization - the chatbot version of SEO, where companies offer tools and consulting to help your site increase its presence in replies to prompts inside tools like ChatGPT. The Promptwatch product uses automation to track responses to prompts across end-user chat products like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. They publish aggregate reports on this as part of their own content marketing strategy, which do seem to provide credible hints as to otherwise invisible design changes to those products. Their own tracking shows a notable change aligned with the GPT-5.6 rollout earlier this month: The percentage of all ChatGPT Search fanout queries that contain the site:operator, per day. The share hovered between 0.3% and 0.5% for weeks, dipped briefly to 0.15% on August 3 to 5 (consistent with a staged rollout or pre-launch experiment), then jumped to 16-17% on August 8. It's important to note that these figures only reflect the prompts for which they have automated tracking enabled. This corresponds to OpenAI's somewhat vague August 6th announcement : For Plus and Pro users, we’re updating GPT‑5.6 Sol in Chat to be more reliable with facts and provide more focused answers. Once again I am hampered by OpenAI's decision to actively obscure their system prompts, but from poking at ChatGPT I believe their latest search tool has a shape like search(query, recency, domains) rather than encouraging a site: operator directly. In a follow-up on August 18th Promptwatch repo
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT 搜尋現在使用 site:operator 大規模 Promptwatch 是新興“GEO”空間的一部分，用於生成引擎最佳化（SEO 的聊天機器人版本），公司提供工具和諮詢來幫助您的網站在回覆 ChatGPT 等工具內的提示時提高其存在感。 Promptwatch 產品使用自動化技術來跟蹤 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 等終端使用者聊天產品的提示響應。他們釋出了有關此問題的彙總報告，作為自己的內容營銷策略的一部分，這似乎確實為這些產品的其他隱形設計更改提供了可靠的提示。他們自己的跟蹤顯示了與本月早些時候推出的 GPT-5.6 一致的顯著變化：每天包含 site:operator 的所有 ChatGPT 搜尋扇出查詢的百分比。該份額連續數週徘徊在 0.3% 至 0.5% 之間，8 月 3 日至 5 日短暫下跌至 0.15%（與分階段推出或釋出前實驗一致），然後在 8 月 8 日躍升至 16-17%。值得注意的是，這些數字僅反映了啟用自動跟蹤的提示。這與 OpenAI's 8 月 6 日的公告相對應，有些模糊：對於 Plus 和 Pro 使用者，我們正在更新 Chat 中的 GPT‑5.6 Sol，以便更可靠地提供事實並提供更有針對性的答案。我再次受到 OpenAI's 決定主動模糊其系統提示的阻礙，但透過戳 ChatGPT，我相信他們最新的搜尋工具具有類似搜尋（查詢、新近度、域）的形狀，而不是直接鼓勵 site: 操作員。在 8 月 18 日 Promptwatch 回購協議的後續行動中

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Pro tops Editorial Craft benchmark with 0.97 score
items.summary: In a 12-task Editorial Craft evaluation of 12 AI models, OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol Pro ranked first with a 0.97 score at $0.0091 per task. OpenAI claimed four of the top six spots, while Grok 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.8 tied at 0.93 among the leading non-OpenAI models.
items.summary_zh: 在對 12 個 AI 模型進行的 12 任務Editorial Craft 評估中，OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol Pro 以每項任務 0.0091 美元的 0.97 分排名第一。 OpenAI 佔據前六名中的四席，而 Grok 4.6 和 Claude Opus 4.8 在領先的非 OpenAI 模型中並列，得分為 0.93。

items_ai.title: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale
items_ai.summary: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale Promptwatch is part of the emerging "GEO" space, for Generative Engine Optimization - the chatbot version of SEO, where companies offer tools and consulting to help your site increase its presence in replies to prompts inside tools like ChatGPT. The Promptwatch product uses automation to track responses to prompts across end-user chat products like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. They publish aggregate reports on this as part of their own content marketing strategy, which do seem to provide credible hints as to otherwise invisible design changes to those products. Their own tracking shows a notable change aligned with the GPT-5.6 rollout earlier this month: The percentage of all ChatGPT Search fanout queries that contain the site:operator, per day. The share hovered between 0.3% and 0.5% for weeks, dipped briefly to 0.15% on August 3 to 5 (consistent with a staged rollout or pre-launch experiment), then jumped to 16-17% on August 8. It's important to note that these figures only reflect the prompts for which they have automated tracking enabled. This corresponds to OpenAI's somewhat vague August 6th announcement : For Plus and Pro users, we’re updating GPT‑5.6 Sol in Chat to be more reliable with facts and provide more focused answers. Once again I am hampered by OpenAI's decision to actively obscure their system prompts, but from poking at ChatGPT I believe their latest search tool has a shape like search(query, recency, domains) rather than encouraging a site: operator directly. In a follow-up on August 18th Promptwatch repo
items_ai.summary_zh: ChatGPT 搜尋現在使用 site:operator 大規模 Promptwatch 是新興“GEO”空間的一部分，用於生成引擎最佳化（SEO 的聊天機器人版本），公司提供工具和諮詢來幫助您的網站在回覆 ChatGPT 等工具內的提示時提高其存在感。 Promptwatch 產品使用自動化技術來跟蹤 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 等終端使用者聊天產品的提示響應。他們釋出了有關此問題的彙總報告，作為自己的內容營銷策略的一部分，這似乎確實為這些產品的其他隱形設計更改提供了可靠的提示。他們自己的跟蹤顯示了與本月早些時候推出的 GPT-5.6 一致的顯著變化：每天包含 site:operator 的所有 ChatGPT 搜尋扇出查詢的百分比。該份額連續數週徘徊在 0.3% 至 0.5% 之間，8 月 3 日至 5 日短暫下跌至 0.15%（與分階段推出或釋出前實驗一致），然後在 8 月 8 日躍升至 16-17%。值得注意的是，這些數字僅反映了啟用自動跟蹤的提示。這與 OpenAI's 8 月 6 日的公告相對應，有些模糊：對於 Plus 和 Pro 使用者，我們正在更新 Chat 中的 GPT‑5.6 Sol，以便更可靠地提供事實並提供更有針對性的答案。我再次受到 OpenAI's 決定主動模糊其系統提示的阻礙，但透過戳 ChatGPT，我相信他們最新的搜尋工具具有類似搜尋（查詢、新近度、域）的形狀，而不是直接鼓勵 site: 操作員。在 8 月 18 日 Promptwatch 回購協議的後續行動中

items_ai.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Pro tops Editorial Craft benchmark with 0.97 score
items_ai.summary: In a 12-task Editorial Craft evaluation of 12 AI models, OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol Pro ranked first with a 0.97 score at $0.0091 per task. OpenAI claimed four of the top six spots, while Grok 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.8 tied at 0.93 among the leading non-OpenAI models.
items_ai.summary_zh: 在對 12 個 AI 模型進行的 12 任務Editorial Craft 評估中，OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol Pro 以每項任務 0.0091 美元的 0.97 分排名第一。 OpenAI 佔據前六名中的四席，而 Grok 4.6 和 Claude Opus 4.8 在領先的非 OpenAI 模型中並列，得分為 0.93。
